key.name: record-dir
key.description: Absolute path where all recordings are saved. Empty = ~/AudioRec.

key.name: bitrate
key.description: Target Opus encoder bitrate in kbps. 24 = speech (smallest file), 48 = balanced, 96 = music / quality headroom (e.g. for later song recognition). Allowed values: 24, 48, 96.
